heroTitle: Holidays crafted around the way you travel.
heroSubtitle: From Kerala’s backwaters and hill stations to beaches and beyond, we plan holidays for every kind of traveller.
introDescription: Every Royal Grain journey is planned with local knowledge, trusted stays and personal support from first enquiry to return home.

title: Kerala Backwater Cruises
shortDescription: Drift through the quiet canals and lagoons of Kerala on a traditional houseboat, with local meals and village stops along the way.

title: Hill Station Escapes
shortDescription: Cool mountain air, tea gardens and misty viewpoints, planned with comfortable stays and easy transfers.

title: Beach Getaways
shortDescription: Relax on Kerala’s coastline with beachside stays, seafood dining and time to simply unwind.

title: Wildlife & Nature Tours
shortDescription: Explore forests, wildlife sanctuaries and spice plantations with experienced local guides.
